summary.para: Start recovering indices and data streams from a recovery point. This API is intended for internal operator use. Depending on the mode, the sources are either replaced with their state at the recovery point, over the data that currently exists, or recovered under new names. The recovery runs in the background, so the API returns with a 202 Accepted status once it has started.

The period to wait for the master node. If the master node is not available before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error. To indicate that the request should never timeout, set it to -1.
How to recover the sources: replace recovers them in place, over the data that currently exists, and rename recovers them under new names.
The exact end time of the recovery point to recover from, as a date or epoch milliseconds. An end_time returned when listing recovery points can be passed back as it is.
How to derive the new name of each recovered source from its name. Required when mode is rename, and not allowed when mode is replace.
The sources to recover. Each value is an index or data stream expression. Wildcards and exclusions prefixed with - are supported. The list must not be empty and must not contain blank values.
